title: policy.json: quota
description: Account limits and the owner's reserve (design part 12.5). Autonomous work never spends the reserve. Headroom is the share of a window's limit above the reserve that remains unused.

reserve.description: The share of each limit kept for the owner's own interactive use, unless a limit sets its own reserve (design part 22, Q11). Moved to the person file (design part 13.4); here it still loads, with a warning, until the person file sets it, and after that only a larger reserve has effect.

economize_below.description: Below this headroom: prefer cheaper models and tiers where sizing allows, and lower concurrency. Moved to the person file (design part 13.4); here it still loads, with a warning, until the person file sets it, and after that only an earlier threshold has effect.

critical_below.description: Below this headroom: dispatch only critical-path items. Moved to the person file (design part 13.4); here it still loads, with a warning, until the person file sets it, and after that only an earlier threshold has effect.

notify_used.description: Shares of a limit used at which a line goes into the digest. Moved to the person file (design part 13.4); shares set here are added to the person's, with a warning until the person file sets its own.

limits.description: The declared limits. A project's list replaces the default list as a whole. The default is the Claude subscription's weekly window, read from status-line snapshots. A Pro or Max plan also has a five-hour window: while the account's latest status-line snapshot reports one that has not reset, the gate adds a claude-five-hour limit unless a limit on the rolling_5h window is already declared. Limits other than run budgets (window: run) moved to the person file (design part 13.4); here they still load, with a warning, and a limit with the same id as a person limit only tightens it.

forecast_hours.description: How many recent hours the burn rate is smoothed over. Moved to the person file (design part 13.4); here it still loads, with a warning, until the person file sets it.

limit.description: One account limit (design part 12.5). Limits whose overrun costs money should be hard (design part 22, Q12). Confidence is derived from source and age, so it is not stored.

window.description: rolling_5h, weekly, monthly_utc, run, or a custom period such as P14D.

limit.description: The amount per window, where known.

scope.description: Which account, harness and models it covers.

hard.description: Exceeding it needs the owner's yes first.

resets_at.description: A time the limit's window is known to reset, as the person declares it. For a fixed-length window, later resets follow one window length apart. Used when no reading gives the reset time, so a pause at this limit knows when to wake.

confidence.description: The owner's stated trust in a declared figure. The confidence the system computes from the reading's source and age never exceeds it.
